handoff: closeStory is a faithful move of story close's effects (same order, errors, output); tests and typecheck green. Minor: mailbox refs in Plan P2 not deleted (unchanged behaviour), slice 09 should decide.

findings.title: Mailbox refs are not removed, though the Plan lists them
findings.detail:
Spec Plan prefactor 2: 'remove worktrees, local branches, leases, the claim and mailbox refs'. The same line also says 'No behaviour change', and released story close never deleted mailbox refs, so these two requirements contradict each other. The implementer kept behaviour unchanged and wrote this down in the handoff. That is the right call for a prefactor, but the gap carries over to GR6b.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Decide in slice 09 (or by a person) whether closing should delete refs/norn/mailbox/<story>/*. If yes, add it to closeStory there, with a test.

findings.title: Two destructurings just to rebuild the output's key order
findings.detail:
`const { ok: _ok, story: _story, branches_kept, record, ...effects } = r; const { leases_released, claim_deleted, claim_error, ...done } = effects;` is hard to follow. Listing the fields explicitly would read more plainly.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Spell out the returned object field by field from r.

notes.text: Plan prefactor 2 lists mailbox refs among close's effects, but story close never deleted them; kept unchanged here. Should GR6b/close delete refs/norn/mailbox/<story>/*?
